card.name: Punctuation and links in narrative lists
card.fires_on: Commas, 'and', 'of', 'was' and opening parentheses inside plain narrative lists or nickname asides, such as a camp's daily food and gear or Hobbit names in a Tolkien summary. Not a drug-label pattern.

modes.label: Nickname parenthesis
modes.description: An opening bracket or first letter of a nickname after a character's full name.
modes.example: Peregrin Took<< (>>Pippin) also took part in

modes.label: Items in a list
modes.description: Commas, 'and' or 'of' inside a list of food or equipment in a historical or camp description.
modes.example: Prisoners woke up around six for breakfast consisting of coffee<<,>> bread, and beef (fried or boiled

modes.label: Joining words in camp description
modes.description: Small linking words or dashes in sentences about camp facilities and issued gear.
modes.example: The only bath facility<< was>> the lake.

card.plain: It fires on commas and small joining words in everyday story-like lists, such as meals, gear and character nicknames.
